data.description: Stable additive cache key (drop github.run_id) + save-always + merge-not-overwrite ledger; bounded retry/backoff on the check-runs API; budget-exhaustion emits a distinct retryable 're-run to continue' status that warm-hits the partial ledger and converges within K re-runs. Ref: proposal P0.a, scenario 6.
data.title: CF-6: coverage-invariant ledger cache-key + API backoff + budget convergence
